title: Standing phlimbo allowance is never revoked on setPhlimbo or setRewardToken repoint
fingerprintBasis: sha256(src/StableYieldAccumulator.sol:setPhlimbo:standing-allowance-outlives-its-grantee-across-repoint-not-revoked)  [entryPoint null -> legacy hash form, byte-identical to pre-entryPoint findings]
description: A repointed-away phlimbo retains spending rights over SYA's rewardToken balance indefinitely. SYA holds ~zero rewardToken between claims, so a stale phlimbo could only skim mid-claim balances, and claim is nonReentrant. Verified first-hand at f704130: setPhlimbo (:405-411) and setRewardToken (:417-420) both repoint without touching the allowance.
impact: Second leg of L-01's blast radius: after setRewardToken the standing allowance remains denominated in the OLD token, so the phlimbo leg breaks independently of the streamer leg.
attackPath: No attacker under the non-malicious-owner assumption; this is state hygiene.
1. Owner calls approvePhlimbo(largeAmount), granting a standing rewardToken allowance to phlimbo.
2. Owner later calls setPhlimbo(newPhlimbo) or setRewardToken(newToken). Neither revokes the prior allowance.
3. The old grantee retains an unbounded, indefinite allowance over a contract it is no longer wired to.
recommendation: Have setPhlimbo forceApprove(oldPhlimbo, 0) before repointing, and have setRewardToken zero the old token's allowance.
knownInvalidCheck: The C4 'approve race condition / safeApprove front-running' exclusion was considered and REJECTED. This is a standing allowance that OUTLIVES its grantee across a repoint — a state-hygiene defect, not the ERC-20 approve front-running race. Separately, the story-026 inline forceApprove at :598 is exact-amount and fully consumed in-transaction with no external call between grant and consumption, so no interception window exists (Tier-3 test_P3_C confirms allowance == 0 after a claim).

mandatoryCrossReference.framing: OPPOSITE FAILURE MODES OF THE SAME VARIABLE. Ledger L-02 is allowance UNDER-supply (depletion bricks claim; function approvePhlimbo; fix = re-approve/auto-top-up). This is allowance OVER-persistence (survives its grantee; functions setPhlimbo/setRewardToken; fix = zero it on repoint). Opposite direction, opposite fix, different setter. MUST be placed adjacent in the QA report with this framing so they do not read as one issue.

doNotCollapseWith.reason: Both are consequences of setRewardToken but must NOT be collapsed: M-01 is AVAILABILITY of claim(); this is residual ALLOWANCE HYGIENE.

preExisting: NOT introduced by story-026. Age is not a suppression ground.
